title: Virus-like particles enable targeted gene engineering and pooled CRISPR screening in primary human myeloid cells
model: Primary human macrophages, transcription-factor knockout library, FACS
contrast: CD80-high vs CD80-low bin, paired by donor (4 donors)
paper_method: Not stated in GEO; paper not open access
paper_calls: TNFAIP3 as central regulator of inflammatory polarization
verdict: TNFAIP3 is BARCS's top gene, enriched in CD80-high cells, with CD274, JUN, IRF8 and IRF9 behind it; the donor-paired model fits cleanly (guide correlation 0.01).
